0022600195.text: The San Antonio Spurs come into this road game at 7-2, riding a seven-game winning streak with a 3-0 road record, and sit 2nd in the Southwest and 4th in the West, but Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain) are both out. The Portland Trail Blazers are 6-2, sit 2nd in the Northwest 0.5 games back, and have lost their last game, with Ja Morant (hamstring), Robert Williams III (rest), Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle) all unavailable. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Spurs won the 2025-26 season series 2-1 and the 2025-26 playoff series 4-1, most recently beating Portland 114-95 in San Antonio on April 28.
